description: Defines data classes and interfaces for package metadata, versioning, and file management in the fdroid index v2 system.

classes.name: PackageV2
classes.description: Represents a package with metadata and multiple versions, with a method to walk through associated files.

classes.name: MetadataV2
classes.description: Contains detailed metadata about a package, including author info, graphics, and screenshots, with a method to walk through related files.

classes.name: Screenshots
classes.description: Holds various device-specific screenshot lists and a property to check if all are null.

classes.name: PackageVersion
classes.description: Interface defining properties for package versioning, including version code, name, size, signer, and vulnerability status.

classes.name: PackageVersionV2
classes.description: Implementation of PackageVersion with details about the package file, source, manifest, and anti-features, including a method to walk files.

classes.name: FileV1
classes.description: Represents a file with a non-null sha256 hash, used as a primary key, with serialization methods.

classes.name: PackageManifest
classes.description: Interface for package manifest details like SDK versions and features.

classes.name: ManifestV2
classes.description: Implementation of PackageManifest with SDK info, permissions, and features.

classes.name: SignerV2
classes.description: Represents package signer information with multiple signatures support.

classes.name: PermissionV2
classes.description: Defines permissions with optional maximum SDK version.

classes.name: FeatureV2
classes.description: Represents a feature with a name.

methods.name: walkFiles
methods.description: Traverses files associated with metadata or package version, applying a consumer function.
